narrative: Aléksa Mil contributed to Agroverse, Cypher Defense, and TrueSight DAO from October 2020 to November 2023, with contributions primarily in strategy development and legal work. He provided a full-scale strategy and rollout action plan for DAO growth, including overview and system logic, and contributed reference materials with ideas for strategy extensions. Aléksa reviewed proposed strategies, suggesting areas to watch out for, raised concerns about moderate issues in governance, and performed detailed legal work aligned with specific sections, paragraphs, and bullet points in legal documents.
